feature_name: Cloud SQL backup migration to AlloyDB
summary: AlloyDB supports migration from Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL by using a Cloud SQL backup, including Google Cloud CLI support; AlloyDB supports setting up clusters by using a copy of a Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL backup.

evidence_snippets: Automatic and adaptive database features The fully PostgreSQL-compatible database engine that powers every AlloyDB node has several features that continuously analyze the structure and frequency of the queries that your instances handle, using this information to suggest schema improvements or automatically apply optimizations: An index advisor helps you find opportunities to optimize your database schema using new indexes based on your usage patterns.

AlloyDB is designed for demanding workloads, including: Hybrid Transactional and Analytical Processing (HTAP): run complex analytical queries against your live transactional data without impacting performance or availability.

You can focus on your data and let AlloyDB handle the following operations: Backups: protect your data with on-demand and automated scheduled backups, and a continuous recovery system that enables point-in-time recovery.
